'''Tarandon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who served as an advisor to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Decimus]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the Imperial invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Tarandon recommended that Decimus convert the offices of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Trade Tariff Service]] into a base instead of occupying the [[Legislature Building]]; Decimus followed Tarandon's advice and transformed the building into the structure known as [[Imperial Central Command (Corellia)|Decimus's Rise]].<ref name="Rise" /> From the Decimus's Rise, Tarandon recruited an Imperial hero to secure a building formerly serving as the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] prison. Tarandon also proposed that the captured [[Republic Foundation Museum]] be converted into a celebration of Imperial culture.<ref name="Museum">{{TORcite|type=codex|Republic Foundation Museum}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tarandon appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
